fields.description: ANAFI UKR is Parrot's compact folding micro-UAV for intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance missions. The manufacturer lists a folded size of 245 x 160 x 116 mm, a mass below 1,033 g with the Standard Smart battery or below 1,365 g with the XLR battery, and a 1,450 g maximum take-off mass. Flight time is 38 minutes with the Standard battery at 6 m/s or 70 minutes with the XLR battery at 6.5 m/s; maximum flight distance is 23 km or 40 km respectively. The aircraft reaches 17 m/s maximum horizontal airspeed, 8 m/s ascent and descent, resists 15 m/s wind and is rated IP53. It combines a 640 thermal sensor with wide and telephoto EO sensors on a 3-axis stabilized gimbal, uses GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou plus optical navigation for GNSS-denied flight, and can take off from and land in the operator's hand. Parrot publishes no numeric price or payload figure.

highlights: Folding inspection drone with stabilized visible and thermal imaging
Front and downward stereo cameras, inertial sensors and optical navigation support flight
Battery configurations have different flight times: 38 minutes standard or 70 minutes XLR at the specified test airspeeds
Parrot lists ANAFI UKR's folded size as 245 x 160 x 116 mm and its unfolded size as 350 x 665 x 116 mm.
The aircraft weighs less than 1,033 g with the Standard Smart battery or less than 1,365 g with the XLR battery, with a 1,450 g maximum take-off mass.
Flight time is 38 minutes with the Standard battery at 6 m/s or 70 minutes with the XLR battery at 6.5 m/s; maximum flight distance is 23 km or 40 km.
ANAFI UKR is rated IP53, resists winds up to 15 m/s and operates from -36 to +50 degrees Celsius with a 5,000 m service ceiling.
A 640 thermal sensor and a wide plus telephoto EO chain share a 3-axis stabilized gimbal with a -90 to +90 degree tilt range.
Optical navigation keeps the aircraft flying when GNSS is denied, and Parrot says it can be deployed in under two minutes and take off from or land in the operator's hand.

fields.description: temi V3 is Robotemi's autonomous indoor personal assistant and telepresence robot. It stands 100 cm tall, is 35 cm wide and 45 cm deep, and weighs 12 kg. A 13.3-inch 1920 x 1080 IPS touch display tilts from -15 to +55 degrees, and the robot runs on an ARM hexa-core platform with Linux and a separate navigation computer. Navigation combines 360-degree LiDAR, two depth cameras, an RGB camera, an IMU and six time-of-flight linear sensors for 2D mapping, 3D localization and 5 cm / 2 inch accuracy, with obstacle avoidance, user detection and following. The lithium-ion battery provides up to eight hours of operation per charge and the robot returns autonomously to its charging dock. It offers Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.1 BLE, USB-C and USB-A, optional 4G/5G, a 13 MP 1080p camera, four microphones and 20 W audio. The tray carries up to 3 kg depending on assembly. Robotemi publishes no numeric price or IP rating.

companyFocus.name: Parrot
companyFocus.role: European professional micro-UAV and photogrammetry group
highlights: Parrot describes itself as Europe's leading group in professional micro-UAVs and 3D mapping and modeling solutions.
The group says it designs, develops and markets micro-UAVs and photogrammetry software for security forces, industrial and commercial operators and public authorities.
Parrot says it integrates artificial intelligence for autonomous flight, detection, tracking and analysis, and positions the ANAFI range for ISR, public safety and technical inspection.
Parrot owns Pix4D, a photogrammetry and geospatial software suite for surveying, construction, infrastructure, agriculture, public safety and environmental monitoring.
Parrot says it was founded in 1994, employs more than 400 people, generated €78 million in 2024 revenue and serves more than 50 countries; these are company statements.
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch154. Native Parrot investor, company and ANAFI UKR pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. Revenue, headcount, country and leadership figures are company statements; no independent market ranking or complete portfolio is inferred.

companyFocus.name: Robotemi
companyFocus.role: Robots-as-a-Service and personal assistant robot developer
highlights: Robotemi describes temi as a video-oriented, autonomous personal AI assistant robot that recognises and follows users, saves preset locations and navigates around homes and offices.
The manufacturer lists a 13.3-inch 1920 x 1080 IPS touch display, a 12 kg, 100 x 35 x 45 cm chassis and up to eight hours of operation per charge.
temi combines 360-degree LiDAR, two depth cameras, an RGB camera, an IMU and six time-of-flight sensors for 5 cm / 2 inch navigation.
The robot is an open platform with a full SDK and app store, plus Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.1, USB-C/USB-A and optional 4G/5G connectivity.
Robotemi says temi is safe for children ages three and up but must not be operated without adult supervision at all times.

body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Parrot publishes 38 minutes with the Standard battery and 70 minutes with the XLR battery at stated airspeeds, plus 23 km or 40 km maximum flight distance. body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Parrot describes optical navigation that keeps the aircraft flying when GNSS is denied, plus hand take-off and landing; this is a manufacturer capability statement, not independent certification.
